brief: JPM US Market Intelligence's September 3, 2026 morning briefing moves the desk to a Tactically Cautious / Neutral view. Fundamentals stay intact, but near-term variables argue for chop. Warsh's comments make the September 16 Fed meeting live, so CPI on September 11 outranks Friday's NFP. Positioning gives no clean directional read, post-Labor Day issuance historically widens credit spreads, September is the worst SPX month, and momentum has unwound 21 percent (JPMPURE) and 34 percent (JPPQMO) from June highs. The desk therefore argues for reducing net longs and potentially a dollar-neutral or market-neutral approach, and the Monetization Menu runs long NDX versus short RTY, Mag7 and Software over Semis and Memory, Large-Cap Banks, Healthcare into midterms, plus hedges of short credit ETFs and long VIX. Feroli forecasts 50k payrolls against the Street's 55k, unemployment at 4.1 percent, and ISM services at 54.0 against a 54.1 survey. NFP is framed as good news is bad news, with 30k to 70k the Goldilocks range. Positioning Intelligence reports August hedge fund returns of +0.6 percent, de-grossing flipping to re-grossing in the final week, and US positioning back near the 40th percentile.
